captions.detailed: A red clamp-on welding vise mounted to a brown rectangular block representing a workbench. It features a fixed rear red jaw with horizontal gray grip plates and a sliding front gray jaw with a stepped profile. The front jaw slides prismatically along two parallel horizontal cylindrical guide rails, while a lower clamping screw with a small handle rotates to secure the base to the workbench.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a clamp-on welding vise with a parallel C-clamp base attached to a workbench. It must include a fixed rear jaw, a stepped sliding front jaw that moves prismatically along two parallel guide rods, and a lower clamping screw that rotates to grip the table.
captions.factory: Define the base assembly using red rectangular boxes to form the C-clamp frame and fixed rear jaw. Create the workbench as a large brown box. Construct the sliding front jaw as a stepped gray box, and attach it to the base with a prismatic joint sliding along two parallel cylindrical rods. Add a lower clamping screw using cylinders and a small rod handle, connected via a revolute joint.
